description: Shared definitions for the InfoPanel document, scene and engine API formats.

capability.description: A capability id: a feature an engine may or may not support (see docs/versioning.md).

name.description: The name of a scene input, value or state cell, or of an item's binding.

nodeId.description: A scene node's instance id, unique within its scene.

itemId.description: An item's id, unique within its document. Chosen by whoever creates the item and never changed.

documentId.description: A document's id: a UUID in lower case.

blobId.description: A blob (asset or other stored file) named by the SHA-256 of its bytes.

colorLiteral.description: An sRGB colour, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA (alpha last, not premultiplied).

revision.description: A revision number, assigned by the engine.

opaque.description: A JSON object the engine stores and returns unchanged and never interprets.
